title: The Component Added to a Granite Ridge Carry-Forward Fee for an Open Instalment Schedule
content:
Where a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass account carries an instalment schedule into the season the pass is carried to, a component is added to the carry-forward fee. The points below set out how the collective answers what is added.

*What is added where the pass account shows an amount placed on it to be collected by instalments and the amount still to be collected is at least half of that amount?* A component of 25.00 is added, because the plan runs on into the season the pass is carried to. "At least half" is a share of 50 per cent or more of the amount placed on the account when the instalment plan was opened.

*And where the pass account shows such an amount placed on it but the amount still to be collected is less than half of that amount?* Half the component is added, which is 12.50.

*And in any other case?* No component is added by this rule.

*What is the share measured against?* The amount the pass account still shows to collect, set against the amount placed on it when the instalment plan was opened.

*What of a pass account on which no amount was placed to be collected by instalments?* It falls outside both cases, whatever the pass record shows still to be collected for other reasons, and no component is added by this rule.

*Worked on hypothetical figures.* On an account where 1200.00 was placed when the plan was opened: 800.00 still to collect is two thirds, at or above half, so 25.00 is added; 600.00 still to collect is exactly half, which is not below half, so 25.00 is added; and 400.00 still to collect is one third, below half, so 12.50 is added.

*Where does the component land?* It is added to what remains after the allowance has been settled.
